contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return the number of complete groups of groupSize that can be formed from items. Ignore any remainder.
contract.domain: Items is an integer from 0 through 100000; groupSize is an integer from 1 through 1000.

inputRoles.groupSize: number of items in a complete group

contract.outputRole: number of complete groups, excluding remainder
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
